levels.surface: أبو أسد عبد الصمد بن عبد الشهيد الأنصاري

notes: «عمي» + a name is one link named by the name alone (rule 7): «الحسن بن إسحاق», «علي بن موسى الرضا».
Ali al-Rida speaks inside the chain (سمعت ... يقول: حدثني أبي) and is not the last link, so he is a narrator, not imam_in_text.
«أمير المؤمنين» is named after «عن» inside the chain, so he is a narrator; he is the last link because the Prophet's words are relayed through him.
